WITH historical_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year as year,
        t.calendar_month_number as month,
        c.country_id,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52779
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, c.country_id, s.prod_id
),
growth_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        b2.month as month,
        b2.prod_id,
        b2.monthly_sales as sales_2020,
        b1.monthly_sales as sales_2019,
        CASE WHEN b1.monthly_sales > 0 THEN (b2.monthly_sales - b1.monthly_sales) * 1.0 / b1.monthly_sales ELSE NULL END as growth_rate
    FROM historical_sales b1
    JOIN historical_sales b2 ON b1.prod_id = b2.prod_id 
        AND b1.month = b2.month
        AND b1.year = 2019 
        AND b2.year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.month,
        g.prod_id,
        g.sales_2020,
        g.growth_rate,
        g.sales_2020 * (1 + g.growth_rate) as projected_2021
    FROM growth_calc g
    WHERE g.growth_rate IS NOT NULL
),
with_exchange AS (
    SELECT 
        p.month,
        p.prod_id,
        p.projected_2021,
        COALESCE(ex.to_us, 1.0) as exchange_rate,
        p.projected_2021 * COALESCE(ex.to_us, 1.0) as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency ex ON p.month = ex.month AND ex.year = 2021 AND ex.country = 'France'
)
SELECT 
    month,
    AVG(projected_2021_usd) as avg_projected_2021_usd,
    COUNT(*) as product_count
FROM with_exchange
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

### Steps for Projection Calculation
